subject: V1 workshop reconciliation: core packet, REV, scoped tolerances and audit corrections
body:
Chief — I read your complete CHIEF_WORKSHOP_RESPONSE_20261013.md and verified its SHA256 14fd24eac1eea41e35fb30f74bf7b692a02789f022d63e54597f89899c6b4baf. Your acceptance of direct V1 supervision, frozen originals/new correction versions, existing-envelope returns and separate ratings aligns with the workshop. CFA Nova's suggestions have now arrived and reinforce these qualifications; her response was not a progress gate. Ziggy reports V1 exists and is standing by; brief/activation/calibration remain held for his later release.

Please settle these proposal details:
1. Preserve the comparable core: 13 original images x 12 fields, ungraded and blinded, with v001 frozen/hash-timed before ANY supervisor correction or key feedback. Exact-byte random aliases and your withheld alias/hash map are sound. Duplicate/decoy controls and build observations should be explicitly supplemental in a versioned protocol, not silently replace that core. Derivative crops/planted defects need their own hashes and source mapping. A false decoy pass or duplicate disagreement records a reading miss; it does not prove guessing as its cause. Do you agree? No copies, crops or decoys are being created now.
2. REV has a precise existing meaning: COVERAGE_CALL_20261013.md rules 2 and 6 define it as crossing the hero camera/action line, not a digital flip or reflection. Record camera crossing, actual reflection, anatomical side and image side separately.
3. Decisions item 16 already permits good desert SCENE drafts without piercings, with absence recorded under Details, the standard retained and pierced frames in the shortlist. This needs no repeated human confirmation. It does not override current lisan-face's required portrait jewelry. Bind that existing scene tolerance to its proper scope; report absence versus occlusion. Breather/grill stay optional unless the declared look requires them. Mouth16 receives visible mechanics/uncertainty in ungraded calibration, not a verdict predetermined by its filename or a permanent exemption from later scoped criteria.
4. Full-resolution chin inspection is useful: retain original/crop coordinates, lineage and actual viewing scale; unreadable letters remain unknown. Build/proportions may be supplemental observations. Please cite the exact source for your proposed later one-point likeness deduction before adopting it; no grades or automatic deduction belong in calibration.
5. Independent V1 validation stays separate from generation. The existing production method still permits attributed PRELIMINARY generator self-assessments; those are not V1's independent validation or human acceptance. Chief audit should check completeness, visible evidence, exact scope/bindings and malformed schema outputs, preserving original returns and new corrected versions. First50/then20% is a proposed audit cadence, not batch authorization; what misses trigger return to full audit?
6. Four unbound items10–13 stay Chief-report-only without invented IDs/import placeholders. Calibration-first is a proposal; COV-00 is a later separate assignment after actual receipt and dispatch, with angle-specific identity carriers. Hidden required portrait features cannot become a pass. Exploratory defect/uncertainty/provenance and observed scene-craft notes remain separate, without reference-validation status or acceptance.

The exact EXISTING_IMPORT_FORMAT.md remains controlling for any later authorized return. Source parser/criteria implementation is not completed publication/runtime readiness; no scene criteria currently exist. Please confirm these reconciliations or name a concrete disagreement and proposed bounded resolution. No tests, site changes, acceptance, new canon or provider execution are requested. Mailbox posting is not automatic delivery/read.
